text:
Subject: Heater not working in Apartment 4B

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in Apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I called on October 3 to report it and haven't heard back since.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s, and the apartment gets cold enough that it's hard to sleep. As a reminder, section 12 of the lease covers the landlord providing heat.

Could the heater be repaired within 48 hours of this email? A quick reply confirming when someone will come would be appreciated.

Thank you,
Apartment 4B

follow_up.question: What name should I sign with? If you'd rather not give one, I'll sign off with "Apartment 4B".
follow_up.answer: I'd rather not give a name, so just sign off with "Apartment 4B".
